title: EELS #30 - Bethnal Green
description: It's time for another EELS outing so you can celebrate the end of Dry January without a moment’s delay! Back in our East End heartland in a pub that dates back to 1742. Close to Bethnal Green Tube and also easy to get from Bethnal Green or Cambridge Heath Overground stations. 6.30 for the usual 7pm on-out. There will be a “cupboard” to store bags, kitchen closes at 9.

title: EELS #33 - Chingford
description: You are hereby invited to join Just Julian and Just Mo on Thursday evening for our very first time as Hares on our monthly EEL run. We are going for the biggest EEL run ever, so come and be part of history! The base run is 5.6km with a few FRB routes which can bump it up to 9km for those who feel like a bigger challenge. We are meeting at 6.45 at the Rusty Bike pub which is across the road from Chingford Train Station Chingford might sound like a long way, but it is a 12-minute train ride from Walthamstow or 28 minutes from Liverpool Street. The benefits of coming to Chingford – Lovely trail run in the forest – great for your knees and beautiful views. The pub have set a corner aside for us to leave our bags and reserved a bigger space for when we get back. Rusty Bike do very good food till 9.30pm

title: EELS #34 - Leytonstone
description: The Red Lion in lovely Leytonstone welcomes us. We have space booked inside but there is also a beer garden in case the sun decides to shine. Meeting at 6.45 for 7.00pm on out (but come earlier if you want). There will be a long(ish) trail and a shorter one. I'm aiming to make it very traily (following in the footsteps of the Chingford hash), maybe 90% on trail.

title: EELS #40 - Hackney Central
description: P-trail from Hackney Central. Gather at 18:45 for a 19:00 kick off. It's not £7/8 a pink and there are Christmas lights in front of the Town Hall, pus green all around. Maybe bring a torch. Fancy dress theme: go fuck yourselves.

title: EELS #41 - Bow Wharf
description: Dearest fellow EELS, hope you’ve all sobered up after New Year and you’re ready for the first CH3astEnders outing of 2025. Place: The recently opened Pretty Decent Beer Company at Bow Wharf, 0.6 miles north from Mile End via P-trail. Next door to a gym. Make sure you go in the right one. Meet at 6:30 for 7pm on-out They’ve got some decent looking non-alc beers for anyone doing dry-Jan along with plenty of real beers for the rest of us. Bag drop available in their as-yet unfinished kitchen.

title: EELS #42 - A-to-B Starting in Hoxton
description: Meet at 6:30 for a 7pm On-Out No point in getting comfy at the brewery as Fishy Fingers and Landing Strip are setting an A-to-B trail to a mystery location! (30 minutes from the start by Overground and close to some great transport links). Fishy Fingers will pick up your bags from the start and drive them to the end, so let the hares know if you're running late via the WhatsApp Group or DM. Once at our destination there will be a fantastic drink and food stop, thanks to Fishy and our co-sponsor Plank! Given it's the beginning of February and everyone knows February has the best BBQ weather, we're doing a BBQ! For those that want to stay out, we will then decamp to a local pub!

title: EELS #43 - Whitechapel
description: Gather at 6.30pm for a 7.00pm on-out The pub has good beers and food--kitchen closes at 9.30pm.

title: EELS #44 - Hoxton
description: Remember it will be the first time this year with daylight saving, so let’s have a good turnout and have a great time.

title: EELS #45 - Highams Park Station
description: There’s only one place to be this Thursday and that is East London for the May EELs run. Meeting at the County Arms right next to Highams Park Station at 6.45 for a 7.00 On Out. On the Weaver line: 25 mins from Liverpool Street or 10 mins from Walthamstow Bag drop with a sitter The hare managed to fit the following into a 5km run (2 x 1.5km FRB diversions also available): · A test for the twitchers · A mini steeplechase · The not tyred challenge · Two truths and a lie round table (with seats) · Mini zipline · Climb the tree challenge · Fjord cross · Lending library · Subterranean adventure At the drinks stop, you get a free drink and free Wi-Fi is even provided.

title: EELS #46 - Bethnal Green
description: Gather at 6:45pm and pack off at 7pm. Join us to bid farewell to Kanye in Globe Town, near Bethnal Green. (Yes, Globe Town is a real place. There's even a globe sculpture on Roman Road to mark it.) Wear something Australian to make Kanye feel at home and don’t forget your cups. There will be a DS, as always.

title: EELS #47 - Farringdon
description: Help the hare celebrate his 3rd decade in London at this special commemorative EELs Hash. There will be a huge drink stop, surprises, etc.

title: EELS #48 - Bethnal Green

title: EELS #49 - Buckhurst Hill
description: This month’s trail is an A-to-B with the start at The Three Colts in Buckhurst Hill on the Central Line and the end at the Rusty Bike in Chingford on the Weaver Line. Meet at 6:45pm for an on-out at 7pm. There will be a runner’s and a walker’s trail. The courses are cross country and are not lit. Light will be fading towards the end, so it will be worth bringing a torch or phone with you to help visibility. Bag transfer will be provided and some limited places will be available for any that would like a lift between the locations. And of course, there will be a Drink Stop!

title: EELS #50 - Bethnal Green
description: Help us celebrate our 50th run at this newly reopened pub. We have an area reserved from 6:30pm for a 7pm on-out. Bag drop is available. About a 3-minute walk from Bethnal Green Station.
